source: Vimshottari dasha (vimshottari.json, reference.md §9) and gochara from the janma rasi (gochara.json, reference.md §10). Horizons and granularity: product choice (user request 2026-11-23: a configurable Future tab).
notes: horizons: the choices offered (years ahead; 0 = whole life, i.e. the full 120-year Vimshottari cycle from birth). granularity: months for ≤ monthsUpTo years, years for ≤ yearsUpTo years, else one period per mahadasha. transitsUpTo: transit milestones (sign changes of Guru, Shani, Rahu) are listed only for horizons up to this many years. Each period's status: 'good' when at least goodIfAtLeast of the three transits are good at its middle, else 'mixed' (calm: never 'avoid'; whole-life periods carry no transit status).
